name: pin-freshness-lag
title: Close the one-release pin-freshness lag
description: Replace assertPinFreshness equality with action-code identity so a tagged tree can carry pins from inside its own release
creator: sdelmas
notes: 2026-08-22: found while cutting v0.4.0. The rule is identity of the src tree and the action.yml blob between the pinned commit and the release commit, not an ancestry window -- design.md discards the ancestry formulation because it deadlocks the pin-advance pull request. Live owner of the release order is docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md section 5, not the archived 08-08-release-v0-3-0-pin-freshness.
